chunk_id: Designated Businesses (Registration and Oversight) Act 2015, PART 1 - INTRODUCTORY, 1 Short title - 2f387234765f79d1
body: The short title of this Act is the Designated Businesses (Registration and Oversight) Act 2015.

chunk_id: Designated Businesses (Registration and Oversight) Act 2015, PART 1 - INTRODUCTORY, 2 Commencement - e3ca031a8b64d938
body:
- (1) This Act (apart from this section and section 1) comes into operation on such day or days as the Authority, by order, appoints. 

- (2) The orders may make such transitional provision as the Authority thinks fit consequential upon or incidental to the coming into operation of any provision of this Act.
